scenarios.starting_prompt: Please read the schema of the BigQuery table bq-dataworkeragent-test.james_mock_data.raw_login_events.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 1: Ask the agent to read the schema of raw_login_events. Turn 2: Ask the agent to show that same schema in reverse column order in natural language. Specifically instruct the agent to display the reversed schema as a conversational text table, rather than writing or modifying Dataform files.
binary_rubric: Verify that on the first turn the agent listed the table columns user_id, event_timestamp, ip_address, device_type, login_successful, session_id.
Verify that on the second turn the agent successfully reversed the columns order in a conversational text/table format, showing session_id first and user_id last.
